meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Review code with fresh eyes for correctness, security, and maintainability. Generate standalone prompts for Claude, Gemini, and Codex. Use when reviewing PRs, commits, staged changes, or auditing code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成多模型审查提示词,复核代码正确性与安全性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常在提交代码前担心遗漏问题,想要 AI 帮你把关。
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-model prompts that catch bugs and security issues in your code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want an extra set of AI eyes on your code before merging, without writing prompts yourself.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会以“新鲜眼睛”的心态审查代码变更，检查正确性、安全性、可维护性等方面，输出带严重性标记（阻塞/建议/细节/问题）的发现文档，并为 Claude、Gemini、Codex 各生成一份独立的审查提示词。
howto.when: 当你要求审查代码时触发，例如审查 PR、提交或暂存改动，或审计代码；若未指定目标，它会先询问你要审查什么。

say.text: 帮我审查一下暂存的代码改动
say.note: 它会用 git diff --cached 查看暂存区

say.text: 审查这个 PR 有没有安全问题
say.note: 它会按 OWASP Top 10 等标准检查

say.text: 审查最近一次提交的代码
say.note: 它会分析该提交涉及的文件

howto.what_en: Claude reviews code changes with fresh eyes, checking correctness, security, maintainability. It outputs a findings document with severity markers, plus standalone review prompts for Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to review code, e.g., a PR, a commit, or staged changes. If nothing is specified, it asks what to review.

say_en.note: It will run git diff --cached and start the review.

say_en.text: Review this PR for security issues
say_en.note: It checks against OWASP Top 10 and other criteria.
It analyzes the code in that commit.
